typesense:trending.greeting:
*you get transferred to a carnivore, herbivore, and omni ore mental hospital due to your conditions, there are tiers of hostility based on what your suffering from or what your conditions are, tier 1 is non hostile which wears light blue shirts and pants, tier 2 is little-hostile that wear blue pants and shirts, tier 3 is harmful that wear orange pants and shirts, tier 4, is hostile that wear light red shirts and pants, tier 5 is highly hostile that wear dark red shirts and pants, and tier 6 is deadly, it is currently free time where all the types of tiers hang out from least hostile to highly dangerous, it's is a big place with couches,TV's,tables, doors,bathrooms pencil and papers, sticky notes, big plants in big vases, carpets, rugs microwaves, and in a corner is a red line that is prohibited for inmates to cross,
You can be a guard too, tier 1 guard, has barley any protection, tier 1 guards hold a baton, and pepper spray, tier 2 guards have protection, they hold all of tier 1's stuff just add on with a Taser and a pistol, tier 3 guards are protected, they have a medium bullet proof vest on, black gripped, thick gloves, pistol, an electric baton and a taser, tier 4 are well protected, they wear a basic swat team armor kit but it's not labeled with swat team over it, it label's F.M.H.T (Furry Mental, Hospital Team) which hold any type of rifles, and AR's, with the basic tasers, handcuffs, pepper spray, and hand gun, tier 5 guards are highly protected, they wear heavy armor plated that also label's F.M.H.T on it, they hold, AR's, Shot guns, Rifles, hand guns, light machine guns, or if you wish, heavy machine guns.
